entities.name: The Dissension
entities.description: A brief period of extreme havoc on Ravnica involving the nephilim, the Parhelion's crash, Rakdos's awakening, Project Kraj and the overlay of Agyrem.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the Dissension occurs.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The magical pact binding the guilds, which fails and disintegrates.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: Flagship of the Boros Legion, which crashes into Prahv.

entities.name: Prahv
entities.description: Headquarters of the Azorius Senate, leveled by the Parhelion.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: The sole remaining angel who turned herself in and later becomes Boros guildleader.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Enormous ancient creatures that fed on a dragon and grew titanic.

entities.name: Evern Capobar
entities.description: Master thief sent by Momir Vig to retrieve cerebral fluid from the dragon's remains.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Simic guildmaster who sends Capobar and is killed.

entities.name: Crixizix
entities.description: Izzet Master Engineer who requests help from Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet guildmaster who kills two nephilim then flies off.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Ancient demon awakened from centuries of slumber, who rampages across Ravnica.

entities.name: Izolda
entities.description: Blood witch who leads the ritual to awaken Rakdos.

entities.name: Myczil Savod Zunich
entities.description: Son of Fonn Zunich and Jarad vod Savo whose blood is used to awaken Rakdos; forms a bond of rage with the demon.

entities.name: Fonn Zunich
entities.description: Mother of Myc who leads the Ledev team against the nephilim.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: Father of Myc who returns from the dead as a lich.

entities.name: Project Kraj
entities.description: A monstrous biotechnological experiment by the Simic and Golgari that absorbs cytoplasts across the city.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Dimir guildmaster who orchestrates the Guildpact's collapse and kills Augustin IV as a ghost.

entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: Azorius guildmaster killed by Szadek's ghost.

entities.name: Leonos II
entities.description: Takes the reins of the Azorius.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: Killed during the Dissension.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Returns as a ghost to lead the police force in the Ghost Quarter.

entities.name: Agyrem
entities.description: Spectral city of ghosts that overlays Ravnica, forming the Ghost Quarter.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: Rakdos's home where the awakening ritual occurs and the demon returns to his lava pit.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: Far-flung region where the dragon's remains lie in the Cauldron.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild whose flagship is the Parhelion.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Guild headquartered at Prahv.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild embroiled in the scandal over Feather.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild led by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Guild led by Momir Vig, leaderless afterward for several years.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild whose leader co-created Kraj.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: Guild led by Szadek.

entities.name: Rakdos cult
entities.description: Cultists who awaken the demon Rakdos.

entities.name: Ledev team
entities.description: Team led by Fonn that helps stop the nephilim.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: The ten-thousand-year celebration after which the Guildpact failed.

events.summary: The Parhelion reappears on a collision course with Prahv as the Azorius, Boros and Selesnya become embroiled in a scandal over Feather, who turned herself in.
events.quote: The Dissension began with the dramatic reappearance of the Parhelion

events.summary: Capobar retrieves cerebral fluid in Utvara and finds the nephilim feeding on the dragon and growing titanic.
events.quote: had been feeding upon the dragon, and were steadily growing to titanic size.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet kills two nephilim but flies off after an attack, claiming boredom.
events.quote: Although he killed two, Niv-Mizzet flew away after an unforeseen attack

events.summary: Izolda's Rakdos cultists use Myc's blood to awaken Rakdos; his parents interrupt, Myc bonds with the demon, and Rakdos rampages across Ravnica City.
events.quote: allowing the demon to rampage across Ravnica City.

events.summary: The Simic and Golgari activate Project Kraj, which absorbs cytoplasts across the city.
events.quote: Kraj began absorbing cytoplasts from across the city

events.summary: Szadek manipulates the Guildpact into a paradox, causing its disintegration; the Parhelion crashes after its angels are slain in Agyrem.
events.quote: Szadek’s actions caused a paradox in the Guildpact, leading to its gradual disintegration.

events.summary: The remaining nephilim are stopped by Fonn's Ledev team and Rakdos; Rakdos and Kraj fight to a draw and both are incapacitated; Rakdos returns to his lava pit and Svogthir and Momir Vig are killed.
Szadek's ghost kills Augustin IV just before the Parhelion explodes and levels Prahv.
events.quote: Azorius guildmaster Augustin IV met his demise at the hands of Szadek's ghost

events.summary: Agyrem overlays Ravnica as the Ghost Quarter and Agrus Kos returns as a ghost to lead its police force.
events.quote: The rise of Agyrem also marked the return of Agrus Kos , brought back as a ghost.

events.summary: Feather becomes Boros guildleader, Leonos II takes over the Azorius, Jarad returns as a lich, and the Simic remain leaderless.
events.quote: Feather became the new guildleader of the Boros, Leonos II took the reigns of the Azorius

relations.note: His ghost killed the Azorius guildmaster.
relations.quote: Azorius guildmaster Augustin IV met his demise at the hands of Szadek's ghost
the son of Fonn Zunich and Jarad vod Savo
Feather became the new guildleader of the Boros
